headline: Executive order signed in January 2021 aimed at protecting police officers, judges, prosecutors, and their families.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this executive order directs federal action to protect law enforcement officers, judges, prosecutors, and their family members. No official summary was provided, so the specific steps it orders are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: The order is aimed at increasing their protection, though the specific measures are not stated in the title.
